title: Roguelike Rock Paper Scissors meets Mike Tyson's Punch Out
author: MosesSecondofHisName
selftext:
Spent the last couple months trying to make rock, paper, scissors into a tactical arcade game. Simple to learn, difficult to master type shi. What do you all think of the trailer? I'm planning to put a demo up soon.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5212740/Ultimate\_RPS\_Championship/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5212740/Ultimate_RPS_Championship/)

Built the whole thing in Codex, with help from ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly, Suno AI. The thing that was hardest to build here was the customizable hand assets--I have 0 background in tech or game design, so maybe that's a simple thing, but I struggled with it. Eventually, I had to build an editor in Unity that allows me to anchor cosmetics exactly how I want them. I find that for pretty much all of my projects I end up building a dashboard or interface of some sort that does exactly what I need it to do and doesn't do all the unnecessary extra stuff that other software includes.

Also, Suno AI is incredible. I had a really specific vibe I wanted and I needed the music to carry some of that. I was able to make a soundtrack for the game that I think really carries the experience.
